## What's Changed * clicking "skip" in onboarding wizard fixed [#444](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/444) * settings widgets fixed, unused widgets removed [#386](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/386) [#476](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/476) [#462](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/462) * add snail and bird speed icons [#450](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/450) * keyboard commands work in upper and lower case [#463](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/463) * remove our settings dialog from system settings, use the app instead [#467](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/467) * remove confusing busy indicator [#473](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/473) * explain the web controls in both wizard and settings [#477](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/477)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/compare/0.14.3...0.14.4
